liveSolo.program.resultAsOf: Result snapshot as of {time}. The video score stays bound to its own fragment.
liveSolo.program.videoWindowEnded: The live video window has ended.
liveSolo.programControl.changed: Programme state changed or the export cannot be verified. Review the latest state.
liveSolo.programControl.confirm: The server verifies the existing export before changing processing. Rotation can interrupt the broadcast briefly; it does not change match results.
liveSolo.programControl.title: Programme health
liveSolo.notice.programStalled: The programme stopped producing new video. Staff review is required.
liveSolo.notice.recordingFailed: A screen recording could not continue. Staff review is required.
liveSolo.recording.failure.archiveCapaci: Insufficient archive capacity. The original recording and reservation remain.
liveSolo.recording.failure.capacity: Recording capacity is unavailable. No export request was sent.
liveSolo.recording.failure.export: The export failed. A new chunk requires confirmed termination and successful raw-file cleanup.
liveSolo.recording.failure.size: The file exceeds the configured export limit. Adjust capacity before retrying import.
liveSolo.recording.failure.uncertain: The start outcome is unknown. Verify the existing export; do not repeat its start.
liveSolo.recording.failure.source: The screen source became unavailable before recording started. No export request was sent; retry only after this source reconnects.
liveSolo.correction.unsavedHelp: The typed reason and replay selections will be lost. Leaving does not cancel an existing freeze.
liveSolo.correction.cancelHelp: Keep the original result and restore the frozen match clocks.
liveSolo.correction.changed: The match or downstream schedule changed. Reload and review the impact again.
liveSolo.correction.completedOnly: Only completed match results can be corrected by a manager.
liveSolo.correction.freezeHelp: Starting this correction freezes affected downstream matches. The result is applied only after review.
liveSolo.correction.pendingHelp: Review every started match before confirming. The previous result remains in effect until then.
liveSolo.correction.replayConsent: Void this original match and replay with new opponents
liveSolo.correction.replayHelp: Original teams, scopes and submission facts remain in the history. New matches start with fresh rosters and no wins.
liveSolo.correction.title: Result correction
liveSolo.program.capacity: The audience is full. Try entering again later.
liveSolo.program.leaseExpired: Broadcast access expired or was withdrawn. Enter again to check access.
liveSolo.program.title: LiveSolo program
liveSolo.program.waiting: Waiting for a published video segment
liveSolo.program.failed: Program playback failed. Retry to recheck access.
liveSolo.program.stateWaiting: Scores and round state appear when the matching video segment starts playing
liveSolo.disabled: LiveSolo is disabled for this competition
liveSolo.noMatchesDescription: An approved team can enter after staff assign its match.
liveSolo.rosterHelp: The captain selects up to {maximum} players. Every selected player must share their screen.
liveSolo.waitingJudge: Waiting for the judge to start the round
liveSolo.media.privacy: Only authorized staff can view live screens. Opponent viewing is disabled.
liveSolo.media.mutual: Both sides may view live screens for this match.
liveSolo.media.delayNotice: Your shared screen is shown to spectators after a {seconds}-second delay.
liveSolo.media.staffOnlyNotice: This competition is restricted to its staff. Shared screens and the delayed programme are not publicly accessible.
liveSolo.media.recordingOn: Recording is enabled. Staff review recordings before any publication after the competition.
liveSolo.media.recordingOff: Recording is off. Temporary video segments serve the delayed live program.
liveSolo.screen.permissionDenied: Screen sharing was canceled or denied. Choose a screen to continue.
liveSolo.screen.interrupted: Screen sharing was interrupted. The match is not automatically paused.
liveSolo.videoConfiguration.title: LiveSolo video resources
liveSolo.videoConfiguration.ratio: Captures keep their aspect ratio. Smaller sources are never enlarged.
liveSolo.videoConfiguration.activation: Connected publishers apply changes after the next policy refresh. Existing programme exports keep their captured settings; the next chunk or new task uses the new policy. Matches are not restarted.
liveSolo.videoConfiguration.programme: The composed programme uses the same bitrate budget for its entire output, separate from each screen. Passthrough recordings retain source quality. Existing reservations remain until cleanup succeeds.
liveSolo.videoConfiguration.invalid: Use even width/height within the displayed limits, 1–30 FPS and 128–8000 Kbit/s.
liveSolo.screen.budgetUnavailable: The browser could not keep the video within its limits. Sharing has stopped; try another supported browser.
liveSolo.screen.videoBudget: Maximum capture: {width}×{height}, {fps} FPS. One video stream, up to {bitrate} Kbit/s.
liveSolo.screen.videoObserved: Observed send: {width}×{height}, {fps} FPS, {bitrate} Kbit/s, {streams} encoding(s). Missing values are unverified.
liveSolo.draftSaved: Inputs are kept while you switch questions
liveSolo.leave.title: Stop sharing and leave?
liveSolo.leave.description: Leaving stops your screen share. It does not pause the match or forfeit your team.
liveSolo.error.load: Could not load the LiveSolo workspace
liveSolo.error.media: Could not connect to screen sharing
liveSolo.error.operation: The operation could not be completed
liveSolo.error.notFound: The match or resource is unavailable
liveSolo.error.forbidden: Your current identity cannot perform this operation
liveSolo.error.configuration: Check the match configuration and selected roster
liveSolo.error.conflict: The match or room changed. Refresh and review before trying again.
liveSolo.error.notReady: Both teams must lock their roster and confirm readiness
liveSolo.error.mediaUnavailable: The screen service or program output is not ready
liveSolo.error.isolation: Execution isolation has not passed verification
liveSolo.error.roundNotRunning: The round is not accepting operations
liveSolo.error.questionNotOpen: This question has not opened for the current round
liveSolo.error.deadline: The server admission deadline has passed
liveSolo.error.questionGroup: No eligible question group remains. Staff must prepare another group.
liveSolo.error.dependency: A required service is unavailable. The operation was not authorized.
liveSolo.error.idempotency: This request identity was already used for another operation
liveSolo.judge.reasonRequired: Enter a reason before applying the decision
liveSolo.judge.confirmDescription: This changes the current match. The server checks the displayed match and round revisions.
liveSolo.judge.reviewRequired: Review the updated match before retrying
liveSolo.judge.screensRequired: All roster players must be sharing. Media, Egress and execution isolation must also pass server checks.
liveSolo.recording.loadFailed: Could not load recordings or authorize this preview
liveSolo.recording.unavailable: This recording is not ready to view
liveSolo.recording.confirm: This decision applies to the displayed recording. Enter a reason; the server rechecks your permission and its revision.
liveSolo.recording.publishWarning: This publishes the player's screen and any visible answers. Publication requires the entire competition and all its matches to have ended.
liveSolo.recording.reviewRequired: The recording or publication conditions changed. Review the refreshed recording and open the decision again.
liveSolo.settings.title: LiveSolo settings
liveSolo.settings.snapshot: Created matches retain their win targets; prepared rounds and screen rooms retain their captured timing and media policy. New preparation uses these settings.
liveSolo.settings.formatLocked: The format cannot change after a match has been created.
liveSolo.settings.opponents: Allow both sides to view opponent screens
liveSolo.settings.unsavedDescription: Your unsaved settings will be discarded. Cancel to continue editing or save them first.
liveSolo.bracket.title: Match schedule
liveSolo.bracket.seedHelp: Order is the seed order. Byes and winner/loser sources are generated by the server. A seeded tournament cannot be added after manual matches exist.
liveSolo.bracket.inheritWins: Leave empty to inherit the configured target.
liveSolo.bracket.seededLocked: This tournament advances through its generated sources. Manual matches cannot be mixed into it.
liveSolo.bracket.confirmHelp: Review the team order. The server rechecks eligibility and active team slots.
liveSolo.groups.title: Question groups
liveSolo.groups.name: Group name
liveSolo.groups.defaultLimit: Leave empty to use the configured {seconds}-second limit.
liveSolo.groups.scheduleHelp: The first question opens at zero. Empty offsets follow position × {seconds} seconds. Offsets must increase and remain below the round limit.
liveSolo.groups.invalidSchedule: Enter a group name and unique questions. The first offset must be zero; later offsets must increase and be below the round limit.
liveSolo.groups.copyHelp: Copy creates independent LiveSolo material and a competition question. Shared environments become per-team. Unsupported patch/checker material is rejected. The canonical source remains tracked.
liveSolo.groups.noTemplate: No compatible LiveSolo or CTF FlagSubmission template on this page
liveSolo.groups.flagsPermission: Copying Flags requires write permission on the source. If you omit static Flags, configure the copied question before starting play.
liveSolo.groups.discardDescription: The draft will be discarded before navigating or loading the server version. Cancel to keep your current edits.
liveSolo.groups.conflict: The group changed or is assigned to an active round. Your draft is preserved; review the server version before trying again.
liveSolo.groups.moveUp: Open {question} earlier in the question order
liveSolo.groups.moveDown: Open {question} later in the question order
liveSolo.groups.copySucceeded: Created {title}: {attachments} attachments and {flags} configured Flags. The independent question is available in the group picker.
liveSolo.hints.title: Published hints
liveSolo.hints.free: Free for both sides; no score or submission cost
liveSolo.postgame.title: Post-event solutions
liveSolo.postgame.free: Post-event reading is free; LiveSolo results do not change
liveSolo.postgame.question: Previously opened question
liveSolo.postgame.loadFailed: Solutions are available only after the whole competition finishes and within your authorized question scope.
liveSolo.postgame.disabled: Single-question solutions are disabled for this competition.
liveSolo.postgame.reviewHelp: This decision applies to the displayed post-event solution version. Publication and return permissions are checked again by the server.
liveSolo.postgame.unsaved: Your unsaved solution will be discarded. Cancel to continue editing.
liveSolo.templates.independentRuntime: LiveSolo environments must be independent per team.
liveSolo.templates.flagSubmissionOnly: LiveSolo templates support Flag submission; patch verification and Checkers are unavailable.
